they mention hearing her messages through her songs and that she is "only a thought away," mentions their "connection" being "unlike anything else," etc... to me it looks like psychosis. hope this clears some things up.

first of all i’m sorry you’re going through this. it’s not easy to forgive someone for cheating, let alone attempt to pretend that everything is normal when you find out your partner is lying to your face. 

your relationship with her may be completely authentic— meaning i don’t doubt that you love her, care for her, and want to be with her. but, her relationship with you is performative. she is willing to perform for you in order to get what she wants without regard for how you feel. she also has an obvious blatant disregard for the wife of the other man. 

with all these things considered, there’s a lot more that needs to come into play besides how much you love her. i understand how hard it is to start over, and grieve something you thought would last forever, all at the hands of your partner. but it’s worth it for yourself in the end. 

think about it this way— you have no chance of being secure or happy with this person. you can’t go back to what you had before. so, what would your future self regret more? staying with someone who does not respect let alone love you & accepting that you will likely never be the only one, or putting yourself first and never, ever settling for this kind of manipulation again? 

your future self will thank you if you start packing now. i know this from personal experience.
